name: Kinji
source:
The beautiful and self-centered one.

A Kiko who collects information as a kabuki actor at a theater called “Kikusatoya” in the Goraku district. A selfish person with high self-esteem, enjoys teasing people to kill time. In contrast to his appearance, he is very strong and destroys things from time to time as a result of his inability to control his power. The most senior one among the Kiko.
